snippet.title: SHIATH  - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Something Horrible Is About to Happen (SHIATH) is an upcoming short horror game where things go terribly south—because of your own actions.

Enjoy this little teaser trailer, and in the meantime, why not check out my other social pages?

Stay tuned!
